description.value: An award-winning Edwardian mansion from 1905, fully restored and operating as a luxury B&B with nine individually appointed guest suites featuring antiques, fireplaces, and Jacuzzi tubs. Located in a quiet residential neighbourhood just four blocks from downtown Victoria's Inner Harbour. Registered Heritage Property with a Canada Select 5 Star Rating.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a luxury B&B in an Edwardian mansion at 998 Humboldt Street, Victoria, 4 blocks from downtown. The rooms/rates page explicitly states 'Wireless Internet' is available in each room. A 'full gourmet breakfast' is included with every stay, but no mention of early or packed options. There is no mention anywhere on the website of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or any cycling-related amenities. The website copyright ends at 2020 and a Covid-19 Update page is present, raising questions about current operating status.
concerns: Website copyright reads 2011-2020; may not be actively maintained or operating in 2026
Covid-19 Update page suggests possible pandemic-era operational changes that may still apply
OSM had no phone; phone number sourced from website only
Adult-oriented B&B (children over 12 only) — not a concern for WWC but worth noting
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate luxury B&B in an excellent downtown Victoria location for touring cyclists, but the website copyright ends at 2020 and a Covid-19 Update page is prominent — current operating status should be verified before inclusion.

Luggage storage.detail: FAQ states check-in allows 'earlier for luggage drop-off' before the standard check-in window

wow_evidence: Registered Heritage Property with a Canada Select 5 Star Rating... award-winning Edwardian mansion from 1905
